Detector de névoa de óleo

A fixed device that continuously monitors and detects oil mist concentrations in engine crankcases to prevent explosions and ensure safe engine operation.

Definition

A fixed device that continuously monitors and detects oil mist concentrations in engine crankcases to prevent explosions and ensure safe engine operation.

Operational example

Monitor oil mist detector readings closely and report any alarm or abnormal value immediately to the duty engineer and bridge.
